rationale: No existing spec covers the Splunk HEC documentation page (SplunkHec.vue), the Splunk-specific token lifecycle (create-with-splunk-checkbox, generate/revoke GUID, revealed GUID), or the /services/collector + /services/collector/health backend contract. ingestionTokens.spec.js covers only generic token CRUD (render, create, validation, copy, toggle, manage-tokens nav) and explicitly does not exercise the Splunk paths. The feature is a distinct area (new Ingestion > Logs > Splunk HEC tab plus a root-mounted collector endpoint) with its own spec_path from run-context. Needs registration in ci_matrix.json under GeneralTests run_files.
